filing_fee_notes: Current formation instructions list 85 online or 90 on paper. Information Report costs 90 online or 110 on paper. Name reservation fee records the paper form's 35.
registered_agent_rules: Designate a resident agent and Kansas registered office where the agent may regularly be present. The office must have a street address, not a P.O. box; an eligible business or the LLC itself may serve.
standard_processing_time: Online formation is processed within minutes according to the official formation instructions; paper timing was not confirmed.
annual_report_due: April 15 every two years: succeeding even-numbered years for businesses formed in even-numbered years, and succeeding odd-numbered years for businesses formed in odd-numbered years.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a Kansas resident agent. File an Information Report every two years.
common_mistake: Using an old annual-report schedule instead of the biennial Information Report schedule.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Formation instructions revised February 27, 2026 list the complete online and paper prices. Name-reservation online price, paid expedite options, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed. Series of an LLC must submit the paper Information Report.
